metadata.question: Is the nighttime light intensity higher in Grindavík compared to Reykjavík on November 21, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band (VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG or VIIRS/NPP/VNP46A2 for daily data) - For specific date (Nov 21, 2024), need daily VIIRS product: "VIIRS/NPP/VNP46A2" - Date: November 21, 2024 - Locations: Grindavík (Iceland, ~63.84°N, 22.43°W) and Reykjavík (~64.15°N, 21.95°W) 2. Masking strategy: - For nighttime lights, we want the actual light values - Should mask out clouds and poor quality data using QA bands - VIIRS VNP46A2 has quality flags that should be checked 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: A city could legitimately have 0 nighttime lights (power outage, etc.) - this would be answer B (Grindavík NOT higher) - If both values are valid numbers (including 0), compare them: A if Grindavík > Reykjavík, else B - C1: No images found for the date - C2: After masking, no valid pixels - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define locations const grindavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-22.43, 63.84]); const reykjavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-21.95, 64.15]); // Define date range (Nov 21, 2024) const startDate = '2024-11-21'; const endDate = '2024-11-22'; // Load VIIRS Nighttime Lights daily product let collection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') .filterDate('2024-11-01', '2024-11-30'); const collectionSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Collection size: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No VIIRS data found for November 2024.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get the most recent image const image = collection.sort('system:time_start', false).first(); const avgRad = image.select('avg_rad'); // Calculate nighttime light intensity for Grindavík const grindavikStats = await avgRad.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: grindavik.buffer(2000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const grindavikCount = await avgRad.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: grindavik.buffer(2000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); // Calculate nighttime light intensity for Reykjavík const reykjavikStats = await avgRad.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: reykjavik.buffer(2000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const reykjavikCount = await avgRad.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: reykjavik.buffer(2000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const grindavikLight = grindavikStats.avg_rad; const reykjavikLight = reykjavikStats.avg_rad; const grindavikPixels = grindavikCount.avg_rad; const reykjavikPixels = reykjavikCount.avg_rad; console.log(`Grindavík: Light=${grindavikLight}, Pixels=${grindavikPixels}`); console.log(`Reykjavík: Light=${reykjavikLight}, Pixels=${reykjavikPixels}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (grindavikPixels === 0 || reykjavikPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Check for invalid values if (grindavikLight === null || grindavikLight === undefined || reykjavikLight === null || reykjavikLight === undefined || isNaN(grindavikLight) || isNaN(reykjavikLight)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare the values console.log(`Comparison: Grindavík (${grindavikLight.toFixed(4)}) vs Reykjavík (${reykjavikLight.toFixed(4)})`); if (grindavikLight > reykjavikLight) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
